title: Find the Githyanki Crèche
html:
Find the Githyanki Crèche is a sub-Quest of the main quest of Act One, Find a Cure. It can be initiated as soon as  Lae'zel is rescued during ⁠Free Lae'zel if she joins the party. For the majority of Act One, this quest is directly connected to Lae'zel's Companion quest, ⁠The Githyanki Warrior.

Objectives

Objectives and journal entries may vary pending player decisions and outcomes.

Find Zorru.
  • "Lae'zel told us that the githyanki should be able to cure us, if we can find one of their crèches. Someone named Zorru should know more."
  • "We found Zorru. Lae'zel will want to speak with him."
Find a Githyanki Crèche.
  • "Lae'zel says that we can be cured at a Githyanki Crèche and hopes to find her kin nearby."
  • "Zorru is dead. We'll have to find another lead to the Githyanki Crèche."
  • "Zorru left the grove. We'll have to find another lead to the Githyanki Crèche."
  • "We spoke to a tiefling called Zorru. He wouldn't tell us anything about the githyanki he'd seen. We'll have to find them ourselves."
Find the Githyanki patrol.
  • "We learned of a githyanki patrol to the northwest. They might be able to lead us to their crèche."
Speak to the leader of the githyanki patrol.
  • "We found the githyanki Zorru mentioned near the mountain pass. We should speak to them - they may know where we can find a Githyanki Crèche to cure our illithid infection."
Find the Githyanki Crèche.
  • "We found the githyanki patrol, but they weren't very cooperative. We still don't know where the crèche is - we'll need to find it ourselves."
Search the githyanki corpses for information.
  • "Lae'zel told us of a cure we can find at a Githyanki Crèche. She thinks one of the patrol will have a map. We should search the corpses."
  • "We defeated Sarth Baretha and her squadron - we should search her body for more information about the nearby crèche."
Reach the Githyanki Crèche.
  • "We learned where the crèche is located. We should see if we can find answers there."
Find the Githyanki Crèche's entrance.
  • "The Githyanki Crèche is nestled somewhere within Rosymorn Monastery. We should take a look."
Find the Githyanki cure.
  • "We've reached the crèche. Lae'zel says there should be some kind of device capable of removing the parasite. We just need to find it."
  • "We've reached the crèche. Without Lae'zel's guidance, it may be harder to find the cure she mentioned."
Go to the Crèche Infirmary.
  • "The guards told us to report to the Crèche Infirmary, where the doctor will inspect us."
  • "Vlaakith and Inquisitor W'wargaz tried to kill us. It might still be worth investigating the Crèche Infirmary for a way to remove our parasites."
Speak to Ghustil Stornugoss.
  • "We found the Crèche Infirmary - we should speak to whoever runs it."
  • "The ghustil, this crèche's medical expert, may have a way to cure our illithid infection."
  • "Though Vlaakith and the Inquisitor tried to kill us, we should still speak to the ghustil. We may still be able to cleanse our illithid parasite."
Sit in the zaith'isk.
  • "Ghustil Stornugoss, the doctor, said the zaith'isk can extract our parasites. However, it sounds dangerous."
  • "Ghustil Stornugoss, the doctor, is dead. There might still be a way to operate the githyanki purification device."
Quest Complete
  • "We attempted to remove our parasites using the githyanki purification device, but it failed and almost killed us. Our parasites must be very unusual."
  • "We activated a self-destruct mechanism, which blew up the Githyanki Crèche. The githyanki purification device will undoubtedly have been destroyed along with it."
  • "There is no time to look for a cure in the Githyanki Crèche anymore. We must press on."

Walkthrough

As part of ⁠Free Lae'zel, Lae'zel is trapped in a cage and speaks telephatically with the party to let her out. If asked why they should do that, she states that she has a cure for the tadpole, but she will only share it if they set her free. Two tieflings,  Nymessa and  Damays discuss how their friend  Zorru was nearly gutted by a squad of githyanki warriors. Assuming Lae'zel is with them, they intend to bring her back to the Druid Grove so that their leader can deal with her. The party can either kill them, or convince them to run away and let the party deal with Lae'zel.

Once Lae'zel is freed, she explains that the cure can be found at a githyanki crèche. They have a special device - a Zaith'isk - which can cure those infected by mind flayer tadpoles. Hearing that there is githyanki activity in the area, Lae'zel suggests they track down Zorru and see what he knows.

Zorru is in The Hollow, near the tiefling's storehouse. If a party member speaks to him while Lae'zel is present, he will be terrified that she has come to kill him. Regardless of the choices made, Zorru reveals what he knows if Lae'zel is around, as he will be too scared to disobey.  Yul, one of his friends was gutted in front of him, and his corpse is near the Mountain Pass. Another of Zorru's friends is in the Blighted Village, labeled as Dead Tiefling at X: 5 Y: 366. She is in the same room as the ogres. Using  Speak with Dead on her reveals that she too encountered githyanki in the mountains.

The Githyanki Patrol

See this transcript page for an in-depth exploration of this conversation and its consequences.
The githyanki patrol is west across the Risen Road at X: -101 Y: 555. They are arguing with a group of Flaming Fists. Suddenly, a red dragon comes down from the sky and sets the fists aflame. If Lae'zel is present, she notes that the crèche must be near and runs ahead to meet with the patrol, temporarily leaving the party. Go with her to start a conversation with the dragon's rider,  Kith'rak Voss.

This conversation is complex, with multiple variations depending on whether Voss speaks with Lae'zel, a gith origin, or any other character. Each variation requires a different number of ability checks to avoid hostilities. This page focus on the path of least resistance, with or without Lae'zel.

Lae'zel Speaks with Voss

If Lae'zel is in the party, the encounter becomes much simpler.

[1]
  • Nod to Lae'zel. Go ahead.
  • [GITHYANKI] I will be speaking on my kin's behalf, Kith'rak.
  • I will be speaking on her behalf, gith.

Choosing the first option allows Lae'zel to speak, and Voss reveals the search for a githyanki artefact. He asks if Lae'zel has seen anything like that. Choose the ability check:

  • [PERSUASION] Mouth a silent command to Lae'zel: 'play along'. (DC 10)

After the DC 10 check, another passive Deception check happens in the background using the player character’s Charisma (and deception proficiency if applicable). If Voss determines that Lae'ze is lying, he commands the patrol to attack.

If the interacting party member succeeds the check, Voss commands Lae'zel to go to the crèche and aid the search for the artefact before flying off.

A Gith (or "Gith") Origin Speaks with Voss

If the interacting party member is a githyanki origin, or is  disguised as one, Voss asks what they are doing so far away from their crèche. If the character is accompanied by non-gith characters or those disguised as non-gith, he questions their company. If the player character is merely disguised as a gith, they must also pass a  DC 15 Deception Check or  DC 15 Performance Check to earn the Kith’rak’s trust. This is also the case if the player character is actually a gith but has non-gith companions present. If a githyanki origin character is alone or accompanied by gith-only companions, there is no check.

If successful, he explains the search for the artefact and demands the party head to the crèche to join the hunt before flying away. Otherwise, the party must fight the patrol.

A Non-Gith Origin Character Speaks with Voss

This is the most difficult path. If Lae'zel is not present, or the player character insists on speaking on her behalf, Voss asks why he should not run them through. The player character must then convince Voss not to kill them on the spot:

[2]
  • [SLEIGHT OF HAND] Silently hold his stare and discreetly prepare to attack. (DC 15)
  • [INSIGHT] You would've done so already if you didn't want something from me first. (DC 10)
  • [INTIMIDATION] I just want passage - if I have to go through you, so be it. (DC 15) (if not a Barbarian)
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR. (DC 18)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You'd sprain your wrist trying. (DC 18)
  • [PERSUASION] I don't know you. I pose no threat. (DC 15)
  • [DROW] Can't you muster a real threat, like flaying or blinding?
  • [RANGER] [FIGHTER] Try it - let's see who walks away alive.
  • [ROGUE] Claim you're an important person. A valuable hostage - or ally.

...followed by a  DC 10 Arcana Check check to perceive his casting of  Detect Thoughts, then a  DC 10 Wisdom Check check to resist it. Wizards, Warlocks and Sorcerers can recognize the spell and bypass the Arcana check, and only need a  DC 5 Wisdom Check check to resist it. The interrogation can then end peacefully with a third successful check:

[2]
  • [ROGUE] A corpse is useless. But a living informant might unearth something.
  • [PERSUASION] I could help if you let me live - search for this weapon, perhaps. (DC 15) (if wasn't mind read)
  • [PERSUASION] You ought to just *leave*. You've no right to decide my fate. (DC 15) (if not a Paladin)
  • [OATH OF DEVOTION] [PERSUASION] Did you not feel the devotion when inside my head? I could be an invaluable ally. (DC 15)
  • [OATH OF THE ANCIENTS] [PERSUASION] You must've seen my knowledge of these ancient lands. I could be of use to you (DC 15)
  • [OATH OF VENGEANCE] [PERSUASION] You saw how ruthlessly I pursue my goals. I can help you. (DC 15)
  • [OATH OF THE CROWN] [PERSUASION] You will have seen my thoughts are disciplined. I make a valuable ally. (DC 15)
  • [OATHBREAKER] [PERSUASION] My fate is my own. You will not take it from me. (DC 15)
  • [INTIMIDATION] Why are you hesitating, then? Try it, I dare you. (DC 15) (if not a Barbarian)
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR. (DC 15 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Give it a try. I'm hungry for a little fun. (DC 15 )
  • [DETECT THOUGHTS] [WISDOM] Read his thoughts.
    • Don't be too hasty. I could prove very useful.

Passing of any of these checks results in Voss letting the party live, granting the ⁠Silver Blades, Silver Tongue inspiration to party members with the Charlatan background. He tells them to go to the crèche - ahead, at the Mountain Pass.

Otherwise, Voss becomes suspicious that the party is either infected with tadpoles or has the artefact, then he flies off on his dragon and orders his soldiers to kill them all.  Sarth Baretha,  Raider Chost,  Raider Zastri, and  Gish For'reth attack the party.

If the remaining members of the githyanki raiding party are killed, the ⁠Conquer the Conquerors inspiration is awarded to party members with the Soldier background.

Lastly, the party can find an  Elaborate Slate on the body of Sarth Baretha. If looted or pickpocketed from her, party members can attempt to decipher it:

[3]
  • [ARCANA] Focus on the object. Perhaps you can reveal its secrets. (DC 10)

Githyanki characters can successfully use the slate with no check. If Lae'zel is present, she can take the slate and decipher it immediately. Deciphering the slate reveals the location of the Githyanki crèche.

Accessing the Monastery

The Rosymorn Monastery is accessed from the Mountain Pass. The party can find the Cable Car Wheel at X: -47 Y: -74 and pass a  DC 15 Strength Check to summon the cable car. They can then climb on the cable car and use the wheel to move towards the Monastery. If this does not work, there is an alternate path to reach the Monastery. Upon reaching the Monastery a cutscene triggers where a group of githyanki warriors shoot down a cultist.

If the party does not engage those warriors in combat, the Rosymorn Monastery Doors are magically locked as they depart, but there are several other routes inside. For instance, there are broken windows that can be climbed through at X: 64 Y: 31 west of the doors. Once inside, there are some drunk Kobolds, who can be snuck past or killed. The party can then move north to the giant crack in the wall. Continuing on this path requires jumping up the rocks to get higher up on the Monastery.

The Githyanki Crèche

From upper floor, party members can move north up the hall, jump across the gap to the east, and then move south, then east to find a set of crumbling stairs. After jumping past the gaps and following the stairs down, the party must move north to a barricade on the western wall, which must be destroyed to walk through. Moving north through the oak door, then west past the statue of Lathander, lets the party find a lever on the wall at X: 78 Y: 49, which opens the monastery doors; this makes reentering the monastery easier.

After moving west, and following the stairs to north, the party can reach the Monastery Basement at X: 74 Y: 80, where Crèche Y'llek can be entered. The githyanki are suspicious to outsiders, but a gith character (or disguised as such) or having Lae’zel present can allow them entry into the créche without a dialogue check. Alternatively the party can gain access by persuading, intimidating, or deceiving the guards.

The Infirmary

The infirmary is on the southwestern end of the crèche at X: 1299 Y: 809.  Ghustil Stornugoss is in charge of Zaith'isk purification and research on the illithids. Speaking to her and revealing that the party is infected with tadpoles initiates the purification.

Passing a  DC 15 Investigation Check, reveals that the Zaith'isk is a synthesis of illithid anatomy and metal alloys. It hums with psionic energy hinting at paths into unknown minds and unseen planes.

Origin Character Sits in the Zaith'isk

Stage one

If a player character sits on the zaith'isk, the device pulses and they feel utter agony, triggering an  DC 12 Intelligence Saving Throw to seek the tadpole:

[4]
  • [INTELLIGENCE] Follow the doctor's instruction. Seek the tadpole. (DC 12)
  • [GITHYANKI] [INTELLIGENCE] Follow the ghustil's instruction. Seek the tadpole. (DC 12)
  • [INTELLIGENCE] Focus the device on your tadpole. (DC 12) (if using it without Stornugoss)
Stage two

Unfortunately, the parasite only doubles down and burrows further, triggering  DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw. The Netherese magic within the tadpoles causes it to fight back again:

[4]
  • [WISDOM] Stay calm. Guide the device closer. (DC 15)
  • [GITHYANKI] [WISDOM] Remember your orders. Bring the device closer. (DC 15)
Stage three

Finally, one last saving throw must be made:

[4]
  • [CONSTITUTION] Keep going. Complete the extraction. (DC 18)
  • [LAE'ZEL] [CONSTITUTION] Pursue the visions you saw. See where they lead. (DC 18)
  • [GITHYANKI] [CONSTITUTION] Complete your purification. Surrender to Vlaakith's will. (DC 18)
  • [MONK] [WISDOM] Channel your ki. Flood the creature with your essence. (DC 18)
  • [DRUID] [WISDOM] Seek the tadpole's essence. Flood it with power. (DC 18)
  • [CLERIC] [WISDOM] Pray for deliverance. Flood the creature with divine power. (DC 18)
  • [INTELLIGENCE] Focus on this ancient magic. Feed it with your own. (DC 18)
  • [WIZARD] [INTELLIGENCE] Study the ancient magic. Trace its forms. Align yourself with them. (DC 18)
  • [THE HEXBLADE] [CHARISMA] Beg your patron to aid the tadpole in its battle. (DC 18)
  • [ARCHFEY] [CHARISMA] Beseech your patron to lend the tadpole a mote of faerie arcana. (DC 18)
  • [FIEND] [CHARISMA] Ask your patron to lend the tadpole some diabolic might. (DC 18)
  • [GREAT OLD ONE] [CHARISMA] Entreat your patron - ask it to lend the tadpole eldritch power. (DC 18)
  • [BARD] [CHARISMA] Harmonise with the tadpole's magic. Amplify it. (DC 18)
  • [PALADIN] [CHARISMA] Share your oathbound magics with the tadpole. (DC 18)
  • [SORCERER] [CHARISMA] Follow the strange magic to its source. (DC 18)
  • [BARBARIAN] [CONSTITUTION] LET THE TADPOLE FEED ON YOUR RAGE. MAKE IT STRONG. (DC 18 )

Lae'zel Sits in the Zaith'isk

Lae'zel insists on going first. The player character can insist that they go first because Lae'zel owes her success to them.

[5]
  • [GITHYANKI] [PERSUASION] I have ably commanded this party. I will be cleansed first. (DC 10) (roll removed if high enough approval)
  • [PERSUASION] You would still be hunting for this place without my guidance. I will be cured first. (DC 10) (roll removed if high enough approval)
  • [INTIMIDATION] Out of my way. Or would you rather I split you in two and walk through the centre? (DC 10)
  • [GITHYANKI] [INTIMIDATION] Back off, or I will personally present your head to Vlaakith. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR! (DC 10 )

Selecting the following option and sticking to it results in Lae'zel turning hostile against the party along with the Ghustil:

[5]
  • Make way, Lae'zel. I am purging myself of this damned parasite.

If the player character tells Lae'zel to go ahead, she eagerly sits on the Zaith'isk, which grants  +10. If Lae'zel is convinced to leave the machine at any stage, be it by trickery or persuasion, the player character gains  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1.

Stage one

If the player character passes a passive  DC 14 Perception Check check, they realize that the machine's subject does not survive the procedure unscathed. The player character feels Lae'zel's mind ripping and rupturing and can persuade Lae'zel to jump out of the machine as soon as the procedure starts with a persuasion check:

[5]
  • [PERSUASION] Get out of there, Lae'zel. You won't survive this anguish. (DC 30)
  • [WISDOM] Call on your parasite. Show Lae'zel what she stands to lose. (DC 30)
  • [GITHYANKI] [HISTORY] Extract yourself. Mother Gith would not wish you to suffer. (DC 30)
  • Plead with the doctor. Lae'zel is in great pain.

Alternatively, if the player character fails the check or lets the procedure continue with the following options, this gives her the passive  Weakened Intelligence:

[5]
  • Endure, Lae'zel. the cure is worth the torment.
  • [GITHYANKI] Brace your mind, Lae'zel. Vlaakith tavki na'zin. Vlaakith tavki na'zin...
  • Wait and Watch.
Stage two

The player character sees a vision of past deceased githyanki and can try to convince Lae'zel to stop:

[5]
  • [WISDOM] Seek answers within the zaith'isk. What is this vision? (DC 21)
    • [PERSUASION] I've seen the truth Lae'zel. This device doesn't cure - it kills. (DC 21)
  • [GITHYANKI] [DECEPTION] Listen to me. I see your flesh pulsing. The zaith'isk will make you ghaik! (DC 30)
  • [DECEPTION] You must listen! The device is changing you. You are becoming illithid. (DC 30)

Otherwise, they can do nothing or urge her to continue which give her the passive  Weakened Wisdom:

[5]
  • Keep focused, Lae'zel. The cure is close.  +1
  • [GITHYANKI] Cry our queen's command. Lash'a'kla!  +1
  • Wait and watch.
Stage three

If Lae'zel is still in the machine, it is possible to persuade her to leave again. The difficulty is either 21 or 30, depending on the previous choices. Attempting to deceive her remains a  DC 30 Deception Check.

[5]
  • [CONSTITUTION] Pursue the visions you saw. See where they lead. (DC 21) (if visions weren't pursued in stage two)
  • [PERSUASION] I have seen the truth, Lae'zel. You will be killed, not cured! (DC 21) (if Perception check passed in stage two or the Constitution check)
  • [DECEPTION] Your tadpole is changing, growing. You have to resist the machine! (DC 30) (if Deception not tried yet)
  • [WISDOM] Focus your mind. Try to overload the device. (DC 30)

Failing the check, or allowing her to continue gives Lae'zel the passive  Weakened Constitution:

[5]
  • [GITHYANKI] Abide the pain, Lae'zel. It is Vlaakith's will!  +1
  • Embrace the pain, Lae'zel. Be pure.  +1
  • Wait and watch.

Alternatively, the party member can try to take control of the Zaith'isk and absorb its power to gain the  Awakened passive themselves:

  • [ARCANA] Draw on the zaith'isk's power, take it as your own. (DC 30)

Outcome

Even if the party member passes all three Saving Throws, the Zaith'isk simply explodes. Stornugoss despairs at the loss of her life's work. If she thinks the parasite is still intact, she locks the party in the room and any attempt to escape causes the Infirmary to become hostile. The result is the same if the party waits for her to return; the occupants of the infirmary enter and become hostile. Despite the infirmary becoming hostile, the rest of the creche does not. If the Zaith'isk survivor passes a  DC 15 Deception or Performance Check to throw her off, she then tells the party to leave.

If the crèche is hostile, the party must fight its way to the infirmary. The ghustil also fights the party, meaning she will not be available to guide a party member to use the Zhaith'isk. Despite this, the scene plays out nearly identically to if she was there, but without her comments or the need to deceive her at the end.

The Kith'rak

If  Kith'rak Therezzyn has not been spoken to as part of ⁠Discover the Artefact's Secrets, then Lae'zel demands the party speak to her. She believes that the ghustil is corrupt and tampered with the Zaith'isk. The party can go to her and ask to see the Inquisitor,  Ch'r'ai W'wargaz, as they believe someone in the crèche is a traitor. Regardless of what is said, she ignores it and says that she knows they have the artefact. She demands the player character show it to her. If they refuse, she becomes hostile along with the other githyanki in the room. Otherwise, she locks the door and says that the party must speak to the Inquisitor.

Consequences

Using the Zaith'isk can cause permanent debuffs to the character who entered it. Each failed saving throw results in a -2 to a stat. The first roll is wisdom, the second is intelligence, and the third is constitution. If Lae'zel goes into the zaith'isk, she also risks permanent debuffs. However, choosing to consume a tadpole removes all debuffs.

A permanent buff known as Awakened can be gained by choosing "Draw on the zaith'isk's power, take it as your own" or succeeding all three saving throws and choosing any option except "Keep going. Complete the extraction." if the player character enters the Zaith'isk.

Companion approval

The Githyanki patrol on The Risen Road:

  • Allowing Lae'zel to speak  +1  +10  -1
  • Speaking instead of Lae'zel  -1  -5  +1
  • Producing the artifact  -1  +1  -5  -5

Outside Crèche Y'llek:

  • Allowing Lae'zel to talk past the initial githyanki guards outside the Crèche  +1  -1

In the infirmary of Crèche Y'llek:

  • Allowing Lae'zel to use the Zaith'isk  +10
  • Insisting that player character goes first because Lae'zel owes her success to them  +3
  • Asking if the extraction will hurt  -1
  • Telling Lae'zel to endure  +1
  • Convincing Lae'zel to leave the Zaith'isk  +1  +1  +1 +1

Notes

  • The githyanki patrol encounter can be avoided entirely by taking the Mountain Pass route by the Goblin Camp. This avoids the risk that the githyanki become hostile with the party, and they can proceed to the crèche.
  • If the party destroys the crèche as part of ⁠Find the Blood of Lathander before visiting the infirmary, the Zaith'isk is destroyed as well.
  • The infirmary holds three different  Mind Flayer Parasite Specimens which can be taken.
